# Fees

Basement charges a **performance fee on yield only** — never on your principal, and never a deposit or withdrawal fee.

## Performance fee — 10%

* **Earn vaults:** 10% of the yield generated by the underlying Morpho position. It's taken Morpho-style, through share dilution, so it only ever applies to gains — your deposited principal is untouched.
* **LP vaults:** 10% of the AERO rewards harvested by the strategy. The remaining 90% is compounded back into your position.

The fee accrues to the protocol **treasury**, which is the Safe multisig.

## Harvest caller fee — 1% (LP vaults)

LP-vault harvesting is permissionless. Whoever calls `harvest()` receives **1% of the harvested AERO** as a gas incentive. This comes out of the harvested rewards and is separate from the 10% performance fee.

## No other fees

* **No deposit fee.**
* **No withdrawal fee.**
* **No management/AUM fee.**

Swaps performed by the zap routers (for multi-asset deposits or single-token LP withdrawals) incur normal DEX swap costs and slippage on Aerodrome — these are market costs, not fees charged by Basement.
